newsitem.title: FRANCE: CADES to announce auction size later on Friday.
newsitem.headline: CADES to announce auction size later on Friday.

text.p: French welfare debt repayment fund CADES will announce a range for how much it plans to sell at its November 13 auction at about 1400 GMT, a finance ministry official said on Friday.

Market sources said CADES, the Caisse d'Amortissement de la Dette Sociale, had sounded out primary dealers earlier on Friday to gauge potential demand. Most said they expected the total size of the auction to be in the region of 10 billion francs.

CADES announced on Wednesday it would be selling its 5.5 percent 2002, 6.00 percent 2005 and its 6.25 percent bonds by auction next Wednesday. CADES said it would sell a minimum of one billion francs in each line.
